description: config.v1 §2.5, §2.10, §2.13: one request against a schema and the owner's state -> accepted, or the refusal the owner sends, before any act. schemas holds the schemas by name, each a list of groups as the view carries them (§2.2), a group's writable being the startup allowlist (§2.16). A case gives op (set, confirm, cancel, extend, persist), group (the {group} of a set's key), request (the SetRequest or ControlRequest, as JSON) and state: revision; pending, null or {token, applied: whether every group of the change is applied, deadline_passed: whether the deadline has passed and its undo not yet run}; last_change, null or {token, set_sensitive: whether that change set a sensitive parameter}; persist, whether the owner has a persisted layer; in_flight, whether an act is in flight. Rows that need more state (an idempotency key held, the event's rate, a reach join near its deadline, the device) are lifecycle.json's. expect is {accepted: true}, or {refused: {code, field, cause (unavailable alone), app (the ConfigError code, app alone)}}: code is core 5.2's; field is "group" for the key's {group}, a JSON pointer into the request (RFC 6901: ~ written ~0 and / written ~1) for a member of it, or null for a refusal about the owner's state or the operation (busy, persist's unavailable). Values are taken in the bytewise (UTF-8) order of their names. An integer is a JSON number written without a fraction or an exponent, within the signed 64-bit range.
